With over 4 years of experience, I've worked with startups and established brands to build products that scale. My approach is simple: clean code, clear communication, and a user-first mindset.

projects.title: Zenith E-Commerce
projects.description: A high-performance enterprise commerce solution featuring real-time inventory and global payments.

details.problem: Traditional e-commerce platforms suffered from high bounce rates due to slow page loads and complex checkout flows.
details.solution: Architected a headless commerce solution using Next.js for SSG/ISR, resulting in a 40% improvement in LCP and a 25% increase in conversion rates.
details.challenges: Implementing robust state synchronization across multiple server-side generated pages and optimizing heavy image assets for mobile.
details.learnings: Mastered advanced caching strategies and the intricacies of Stripe's webhooks for reliable payment processing.

projects.title: Neural Muse AI
projects.description: Modern AI dashboard for art generation using sophisticated prompt engineering and multi-model support.

details.problem: AI generation tools often provide overwhelming interfaces that intimidate non-technical creative users.
details.solution: Designed a minimal, intentional UI that uses step-by-step progressive disclosure to guide users from prompt to masterpiece.
details.challenges: Managing asynchronous API streams for real-time image generation while maintaining 60FPS UI performance.
details.learnings: Gained deep insights into prompt engineering and efficient handling of large binary data streams in the browser.

projects.title: Astra Analytics
projects.description: Real-time data visualization platform for SaaS companies with predictive churn modeling.

details.problem: Companies had data but couldn't derive actionable insights in real-time.
details.solution: Built a custom D3 dashboard integrated with a streaming data pipeline.
details.learnings: Advanced SQL optimization and real-time data streaming patterns.

projects.title: Crypto Pulse
projects.description: A live cryptocurrency tracker with sentiment analysis from social media feeds.

details.problem: Traders need more than just price; they need sentiment.
details.solution: Integrated Twitter API to perform real-time sentiment analysis on top coins.
details.challenges: Rate limiting and data normalization from varied sources.
details.learnings: Mastered complex state management and API orchestration.

projects.title: Eco Flow
projects.description: Inventory management API for sustainable supply chains with carbon footprint tracking.

details.problem: Transparency in supply chains is often missing at the carbon level.
details.solution: Created a GraphQL API that calculates carbon offsets for each shipping step.
details.challenges: Complex recursive queries for deep supply chain structures.
details.learnings: Deep understanding of GraphQL performance and backend caching.

projects.title: Nexus Social
projects.description: Decentralized social networking concept with user-owned data and privacy controls.

details.problem: Centralized social media compromises user data privacy.
details.solution: Built a proof-of-concept social network where data is stored on decentralized nodes.
details.challenges: Ensuring fast data retrieval from a decentralized network.
details.learnings: Exploration of Web3 technologies and decentralized identity.

blogs.title: The Art of the 100ms Page Load
blogs.excerpt: Technical breakdown of optimization techniques including code-splitting, tree-shaking, and the power of CDN edges.
blogs.content: Optimizing web performance isn't just about small assets; it's about the critical rendering path. In this article, I explore how modern frameworks like Vite and Next.js handle data hydration and how we can prune unnecessary execution to achieve instantaneous interaction.

blogs.title: Clean Code in the Age of AI Co-pilots
blogs.excerpt: How to maintain architectural integrity when using AI tools for rapid prototyping and logic generation.
blogs.content: As AI becomes a standard part of our IDE, the role of a developer shifts from a writer to an editor. We must hold AI-generated code to the same (if not higher) standards of readability and testability that we set for ourselves.
